news.title: Democrats’ progressive surge could complicate Jeffries’s path to unity
news.summary: Democrats’ string of left-wing primary wins is giving the party’s progressive flank a burst of momentum — and potentially handing House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-N.Y.) a new headache should Democrats take back the House.
